pages.text: "Grub," said Yara, "do you like your bog?"
pages.picture: girl talking to the mud monster

pages.text: Grub sighs. "No," he said. "It is wet and it is dark. Mud gets in my ears and in my hair."
pages.picture: grumpy mud monster dripping with mud

pages.text: "I wish I had a hot rock in the sun to sit on."
pages.picture: the monster dreaming of a sunny rock

pages.text: "Fizz can help," said Yara. "He is a dragon. Dragons are hot!"
pages.picture: girl pointing proudly at the dragon

pages.text: Fizz huffs and puffs. He puffs and huffs. A hot wind sweeps across the bog.
pages.picture: dragon blowing a warm wind over the bog

pages.text: The mud gets hard and cracks. Steam curls up and up.
pages.picture: dried cracked mud with steam rising

pages.text: Grub sits down on a hot, flat rock in the sun.
pages.picture: the monster sitting happily on a sunny rock

pages.text: "Oh!" said Grub. "This is the best day!"
"You can go past my bog," said Grub. "And if you need help, just shout for Grub!"
Yara and Fizz run on. Dragon Hill looms near.
pages.picture: girl and dragon running toward a looming hill
